artworks.title: Trabrennen XII
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn cart in motion. The image shows a depiction of two horses pulling a small cart. The sketch is minimalistic, using only a few lines to convey the speed and motion of the horses and cart. The horses are drawn in mid-gallop, with their legs extended, and the driver is seated at the back, holding the reins. The simplicity and fluidity of the lines emphasize the dynamic movement of the scene. The overall composition suggests a sense of urgency and energy.

artworks.title: Trabrennen XIII
artworks.description: This is an image showing a horse race. It displays a racetrack with several horses running with jockeys on their backs. The foreground shows a crowd of people watching the race, while the background is less detailed to highlight the main action of the race.

artworks.title: Saint Augustine
artworks.description: The image portrays a man seated at a desk with a quill in hand, writing. He wears a mitre and robes, with a halo above his head. Various objects, including a book, key, ink bottle, and vial, are on the desk. Surrounding him is an ornate architectural setting with columns and a doorway. Cherub-like figures are depicted below him.

artworks.title: Three Figures
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures standing side by side in various poses. The figure on the left wears a cap and a long coat, with hands in pockets. The middle figure is slightly leaning forward with a wide-brimmed hat and a scarf. The figure on the right is holding a child wrapped in a blanket and is dressed in a long dress with an outer garment. All figures have minimal facial details and the background is plain, with rough pencil strokes outlining the scene.

artworks.title: Anno Domini MCMXVI Post Christum Natum
artworks.description: The image shows two men embracing. The man on the left stands slightly behind the man on the right, with a hand on the other's shoulder. Both men have beards and are dressed in flowing robes. In the background, there are three crosses on a hill.

artworks.title: Child's Funeral in Russia
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural village scene. The central figure is holding a large book or object, with two smaller figures on either side. The landscape includes a dirt road, houses, and various individuals. The sky has scattered clouds and there are trees throughout. The drawing features sketchy pencil strokes that add texture to the scene.

artworks.title: The Dog Catcher
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a dynamic composition. The scene shows several figures draped in flowing garments, depicted in strong black lines on a light background. The figures appear to be in motion, with exaggerated postures and facial expressions. The background features abstracted natural elements like swooping lines. The style is reminiscent of early 20th-century modernist art.

artworks.title: The Fugitives
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two people running or walking swiftly in profile. The person in front is slightly ahead, positioned to the right. Both individuals are partially crouched with their legs bent. Their facial features are depicted with simple lines, with the person in the front having fuller features and visible expressions. Both have short, tousled hair. They are wearing loose, flowing, long-sleeved clothing. There is no visible jewelry, and they are not holding any objects. The background consists of swirling lines suggesting a dynamic environment, with no specific objects or scenery detailed.

artworks.title: The Assault
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures depicted in mid-motion, crouching and holding objects. The image is rendered in a sketch-like style using bold graphite lines. The figures are shown from the side, with one in the foreground and the other in the background, both enveloped in fluid lines that suggest movement. The background has a series of vertical and horizontal lines that add depth to the drawing, suggesting a dynamic environment. The overall mood conveys energy and urgency, with the quick pencil strokes emphasizing the tense atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Blessed are the Merciful
artworks.description: The image depicts a robed figure crouching and another sitting figure holding a stick. The robed figure is on the left, appearing to support the other figure. The drawing uses thick lines to convey movement and emotion. The figures' poses suggest care or compassion. The background is composed of sweeping lines, giving a sense of the setting. The drawing captures a moment of interaction and support.

artworks.title: Italian Peasants with Wine Flasks
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink over charcoal on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two people. The figure on the left is sitting up, holding an object that resembles a bottle, while the person on the right is lying down with an arm resting on the covers. Both individuals have roughly sketched facial features and hair, with the person on the left having short or bald hair, and the person on the right having curly hair. They are dressed in loosely drawn garments. In the background, there are two animals, possibly horses, in a natural setting with simple contour markings indicating undulating terrain.

artworks.title: The Raging Barbarian
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic sketch showing a person in a bent, crouched pose with both arms bent at the elbows, fists clenched. The individual's facial features include a pronounced brow, large eyes, distinct nose and mouth, and rough-textured hair swept back. The clothing is depicted with flowing lines, creating a swirling effect around the figure. The background consists of heavy, horizontal strokes that suggest dynamic movement around the person.

artworks.title: The Writing Prophet (Saint John on Patmos)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a crouched position, with their knees bent and hands resting on the ground. The figure has an elongated face with prominent cheekbones and a furrowed brow. They have short, disheveled hair and are wearing loose clothing. The person's feet are bare and the environment consists of rough, jagged black and white lines, creating a textured background. There are no visible accessories or objects in the scene.

artworks.title: Street in Warsaw
artworks.description: The image features two individuals in the foreground, one reclined with one arm rested on an elevated surface and the other arm extended. Both individuals are cloaked in large attire with broad, swirling lines. In the background, there is an implied crowd or procession in a dense urban setting.

artworks.title: City Square
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from an elevated viewpoint. The scene features detailed lines and cross-hatching creating a textured appearance. The palette is monochromatic, using black ink on a light background. In the foreground, groups of people walk in different directions, and there are early automobiles and horse-drawn carriages. Trees with bare branches frame the scene. In the background, more people, vehicles, and buildings are visible, continuing the activity into the distance.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a path lined by bare trees. The path curves left towards buildings stretching into the distance. The horizon is not visible. The scene features delicate linework typical of etching, with intricate tree branches. The color palette is monochromatic with dark lines on an off-white background. Individuals are loosely sketched in the distance.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a residential area with barren trees, rooftops of houses, and people walking along fences. The trees sway in the wind, their branches extending in various directions. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic black and white style, with expressive lines creating a sense of movement and a sketch-like quality. The horizon is high, showing rooftops and the sun above it.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man (Der Sündenfall)
artworks.description: Bold black shapes and lines form two human-like figures engaged with a tall, twisting column at the center of the composition. The interaction of light and dark areas creates textured patterns. The curving lines and shapes evoke silhouettes of people dancing or gazing towards each other. The background is filled with expressive, radiating lines.

artworks.title: The Barn
artworks.description: The image shows three pencil sketches of farm animals in a barn setting. The first sketch has two horses at a feeding trough, the second has two adult horses and a colt, and the third has three cows in a stall. The sketches are in various shades of gray. The arrangement of the animals differs in each sketch.

artworks.title: Brudermord (Cain and Abel)
artworks.description: The image features bold, dynamic lines and contrasting shapes forming an abstract composition. The overlapping lines and forms suggest outlines of human figures in motion, appearing engaged in interaction or struggle. The angular lines and shadows create a sense of movement and drama.

artworks.title: Christus am Kreuz (The Crucifixion)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The central figure is portrayed with arms outstretched in a crucifixion pose in a monochromatic black and white scheme. The illustration depicts a halo surrounding the head of the central figure. To the left and right, two additional figures are present, each rendered with sharp lines. The figures are surrounded by a background of abstract lines, enhancing the intensity of the composition. This is in the style of Emil Nolde, known for his expressionist approach to religious subjects and use of woodcut techniques.

artworks.title: Austreibung aus dem Paradies (The Expulsion from Paradise)
artworks.description: The image features bold, contrasting lines and shapes that swirl and converge, creating a dense abstract composition. Three humanoid figures are depicted, with one central figure wrapped in elongated lines. Other figures nearby suggest familiar human poses and expressions. The background includes lines resembling sharp peaks or mountains.

artworks.title: Götz von Berlichingen
artworks.description: The image depicts two standing figures and a horse in black silhouette against a lighter background. The figures appear to be in motion, with one slightly more pronounced in the foreground and the horse's head visible between them. The textures are rough with confident, broad strokes, conveying a sense of dynamic movement and tension. The style is reminiscent of George Grosz.

artworks.description: This pencil sketch features a wooden barrel and a large covered container in the foreground. To the left, a rustic kitchen area is depicted with a stove, pots, a kettle, and a chimney. The color palette is primarily grey.
